0022600142.text: The Thunder, 4-0 and first in the Northwest and first in the West, visit the Mavericks, who are 2-2, third in the Southwest and two games back, and eighth in the West. Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (shoulder), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), Otega Oweh (Achilles, surgery) and Thomas Sorber (knee), and Alex Caruso (ankle) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Dallas is without Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Naji Marshall (illness), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series, and the Thunder won the 2025-26 series 3-0, including a 100-87 win in Dallas on March 1, 2026.
